import AlgebraicJacobian.Algebra.LaurentReducedReduction
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LaurentTwoChartCoboundary

open Polynomial LaurentPolynomial
namespace ProbePicC7
open AlgebraicGeometry
variable {A B : Type} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]

noncomputable abbrev redL (φ : A →+* B) :
    LaurentPolynomial A →+* LaurentPolynomial B :=
  AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom ℤ φ

theorem redL_C (φ : A →+* B) (a : A) :
    redL φ (LaurentPolynomial.C a) = LaurentPolynomial.C (φ a) := by
  simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom, LaurentPolynomial.C, AddMonoidAlgebra.single]
  sorry

theorem redL_T (φ : A →+* B) (n : ℤ) :
    redL φ (LaurentPolynomial.T n) = LaurentPolynomial.T n := by
  simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom, LaurentPolynomial.T]
  sorry

end ProbePicC7
